cards.title: Fall Fest
cards.subtitle: Annual October campus celebration
cards.notes: Look for the October schedule and pick one listed component, such as SJU Fest, Family Weekend programming, or an athletic event.
cards.short_summary: An October celebration that gathers academic, alumni, family, and athletic events.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes Fall Fest as an annual October celebration encompassing athletic events, SJU Fest, Career Fair, Family Weekend, and alumni events.
cards.access_notes: Specific Fall Fest events and any entry requirements vary annually.

cards.title: Winter Carnival
cards.subtitle: Seasonal campus celebration
cards.notes: Watch Campus Activities announcements for the winter program lineup, which is designed around diverse holiday traditions and observances.
cards.short_summary: A campus winter celebration with programming recognizing diverse holiday traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s says Winter Carnival commemorates diverse cultural, faith, and religious holiday traditions and includes a week of festivities.
cards.access_notes: Events change by year; confirm the current Winter Carnival schedule before attending.

cards.title: Ice Skating in New York
cards.subtitle: Winter Carnival city outing
cards.notes: If it appears on the Winter Carnival schedule, review trip instructions and registration details before joining fellow students for the city outing.
cards.short_summary: A Winter Carnival trip that takes St. John’s students ice skating in New York City.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists Ice Skating in New York as a Winter Carnival event that takes students to ice skate in the city.
cards.access_notes: Offered-event status, registration, and transportation details should be confirmed for the current year.

cards.title: Central Park Christmas
cards.subtitle: Winter Carnival campus program
cards.notes: Visit during Winter Carnival if scheduled to see the campus program with seasonal performers, then verify the time and location in advance.
cards.short_summary: A campus program that brings a Central Park holiday atmosphere to St. John’s.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s lists Central Park Christmas as a Winter Carnival event featuring carolers and toy-soldier performers.
cards.access_notes: This is listed as a possible Winter Carnival event; verify that it is scheduled this year.

cards.title: Winter Carnival Dessert Party
cards.subtitle: D’Angelo Center holiday program
cards.notes: Check whether the Dessert Party is on this year’s Winter Carnival schedule, then stop by the D’Angelo Center for the listed music program.
cards.short_summary: A Winter Carnival gathering centered on holiday treats and live music.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists a Dessert Party at the D’Angelo Center, with holiday treats and live music, among Winter Carnival events.
cards.access_notes: This is a possible Winter Carnival offering; review the current program for availability and entry details.

cards.title: Spring Month
cards.subtitle: April series before finals
cards.notes: Use the spring calendar to find a program presented with student organizations, then plan around the end-of-semester event timing.
cards.short_summary: An April collection of student-focused activities near the end of the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes Spring Month as an annual April month of events created with student organizations and designed to occur before finals week.
cards.access_notes: Programs vary each year; consult the current Campus Activities schedule.

cards.title: Senior Week
cards.subtitle: Graduating-class event week
cards.notes: Eligible graduating students should check the current Senior Week listing, ticket instructions, and required identification before selecting an event.
cards.short_summary: A closing-week program of events for St. John’s graduating students.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes Senior Week as a week of events for the graduating class and notes past activities including a barbecue, museum trip, sports, and dinners.
cards.access_notes: For graduating students; the University states tickets may be required and events are first-come, first-served.

cards.title: Stormin’ Loud
cards.subtitle: End-of-year outdoor festival
cards.notes: Look for the end-of-year announcement and confirm the event’s schedule and entry rules before heading to this student-designed outdoor festival.
cards.short_summary: An end-of-academic-year outdoor festival produced by several St. John’s student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s describes Stormin’ Loud as an outdoor festival at the end of the academic year, created by and for St. John’s students.
cards.access_notes: Festival details, attractions, and admission requirements should be confirmed in the current announcement.

cards.title: Relay For Life
cards.subtitle: American Cancer Society charity walk
cards.notes: Follow the current St. John’s Relay information to learn the format, fundraising options, and participation details for this community service event.
cards.short_summary: A St. John’s community fundraiser and overnight walk supporting the American Cancer Society.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s reports that its community has held Relay For Life since 2006 and identifies it as a 12-hour overnight charity walk in Carnesecca Arena.
cards.source_title: 150 Reasons to Love St. John’s: A Tradition of Traditions | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current event’s date, format, registration, and fundraising requirements with its organizers.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at St. John's University-New York, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe Queens-campus sequence: get oriented, find practical resources, add movement and culture, then leave with a familiar route for the week ahead.

cards.title: Start with an Orientation Leader
cards.subtitle: Friday · New Student Orientation
cards.notes: Use your Orientation Leader as a first point of contact, then ask where to find the offices or groups that match one practical need this weekend.
cards.short_summary: Begin with the program designed to introduce new students to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s states that Orientation Leaders serve as personal guides during New Student Orientation.
cards.source_title: New Student Orientation | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is for participating new students; consult the University's current orientation communications for timing.

cards.title: Make the DAC Living Room Your Reset Point
cards.subtitle: Friday · D’Angelo Center, second floor
cards.notes: Stop in to recognize the lounge before the week begins. It is a simple place to pause, compare schedules, and decide your next campus errand.
cards.short_summary: A named second-floor lounge in the D’Angelo Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists the DAC Living Room Lounge on the second floor of the D’Angelo Center as a commuter resource.
cards.source_title: Commuter Student Life | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: Campus spaces and access may depend on University status and StormCard access.

cards.title: Locate Campus Concierge Before You Need It
cards.subtitle: Friday · D’Angelo Center, second floor
cards.notes: Find the desk across from the Living Room and save its location for a later question about campus events, services, or discounted cultural tickets.
cards.short_summary: A campus information and ticketing resource in the DAC.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Concierge is located on the D’Angelo Center’s second floor and provides information on campus events and services.
cards.access_notes: The University lists hours as Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; check for changes before visiting.

cards.title: Put the Engagement Center on Your Map
cards.subtitle: Friday · D’Angelo Center, Room 125
cards.notes: Visit or note Room 125 as the follow-up point for student-organization information, especially if you miss an activities fair during the semester.
cards.short_summary: A named campus hub for connecting with student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s identifies the Student Engagement Resource Center in D’Angelo Center Room 125 as a place to get involved after missing an activities fair.
cards.source_title: Commuter Student Life | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: The University lists hours as Monday–Thursday 9 a.m.–7 p.m. and Friday 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; verify changes before going.

cards.title: Take the Marked Fitness Trail
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Start outside the DAC near Spirit Rock
cards.notes: Choose the one-mile or 1.5-mile marked route. Start outside the D’Angelo Center near Spirit Rock and follow the light-pole markers for your route.
cards.short_summary: A choice of two marked walking and running loops on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s maintains one-mile and 1.5-mile fitness trails on the Queens campus, both starting outside the D’Angelo Center near Spirit Rock.
cards.access_notes: Use the posted trail map and normal pedestrian awareness; routes are outdoors on campus.

cards.title: Find the Carnesecca Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Carnesecca Fitness Center, Room B-02
cards.notes: Locate the recreation office and fitness-center area so a future workout feels straightforward. Bring an active StormCard if you plan to use recreation facilities.
cards.short_summary: The Queens-campus base for Campus Recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The University lists the Campus Recreation office in Carnesecca Fitness Center, Room B-02, and states that a valid St. John’s ID is required for fitness-center use.
cards.access_notes: Regular Campus Recreation hours are listed as 8 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday, 8 a.m.–8 p.m. Friday, and 11 a.m.–7 p.m. weekends; hours can change for closures.

cards.title: Find the Learning Commons Before Classes Intensify
cards.subtitle: Saturday · St. Augustine Hall, Room 103
cards.notes: Walk to Room 103 next to Einstein Bagels and note the tutoring location. Bring your StormCard when you return for an appointment or a walk-in check.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus tutoring location in the library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Learning Commons offers in-person and virtual tutoring and is located in St. Augustine Hall (Library), Room 103.
cards.source_title: University Learning Commons | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: The University says students need StormCards to enter this space; it lists Sunday evening online tutoring, rather than in-person Sunday access.

cards.entity_name: Dr. M. T. Geoffrey Yeh Art Gallery
cards.title: See What Is Showing at Yeh Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday · Sun Yat Sen Hall
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition page, then visit the gallery in Sun Yat Sen Hall during posted hours. Use the accessible rear entrance if needed.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary-art gallery with changing exhibitions on the Queens campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dr. M. T. Geoffrey Yeh Art Gallery exhibits contemporary art on the Queens campus and is located in Sun Yat Sen Hall.
cards.source_title: Dr. M. T. Geoffrey Yeh Art Gallery | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Tuesday–Friday 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Saturday noon–5 p.m., plus appointments; confirm the current exhibition and access before visiting.

cards.title: Build in a Quiet Church Stop
cards.subtitle: Sunday · St. Thomas More Church, Queens campus
cards.notes: If a quiet, reflective pause fits your weekend, visit the church during its published open hours. This is a campus option; participation in services is personal.
cards.short_summary: A named Queens-campus church open daily for private prayer.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s states that St. Thomas More Church on the Queens campus is open daily from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Your Faith & Ministry | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: The University lists daily access from 7:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.; service schedules and access can change.

cards.title: Finish by Saving the Campus Map
cards.subtitle: Sunday · Queens campus
cards.notes: Open the official map and save it for your first week. Use it to connect the named stops you visited with classrooms, dining, transit, and other services.
cards.short_summary: The official reference for named Queens-campus destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John’s publishes a Queens Campus Map and Directory listing campus buildings, services, athletic facilities, and dining locations.
cards.source_title: Queens Campus Map and Directory | St. John's University
cards.access_notes: The University gives the Queens-campus address as 8000 Utopia Parkway; use the current map for location changes.
